import React, { useState } from 'react'; import AlertsPanel from '../components/AlertsPanel'; import { AlertTriangle, ShieldAlert, CheckCircle2, Bell, BellOff, Filter, Plus, Sliders, X, Volume2, VolumeX, Clock, ShieldCheck, Zap, } from 'lucide-react'; const AlertsPage = () => { const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('ALL'); // ALL | CRITICAL | WARNING | INFO const [showRuleModal, setShowRuleModal] = useState(false); const [toast, setToast] = useState(null); // Live Telemetry Alarm Rules const [alarmRules, setAlarmRules] = useState([ { id: 'RULE-101', name: 'Motor Thermal Overheat', metric: 'Temperature (°C)', operator: '>', limit: '75.0 °C', severity: 'Critical', action: 'Dispatch Urgent Work Order & Throttle Loom Speed' }, { id: 'RULE-102', name: 'High Yarn Snap Risk', metric: 'Yarn Tension (cN)', operator: '>', limit: '24.0 cN', severity: 'Warning', action: 'Auto-adjust weft insertion feeder speed (-50 RPM)' }, { id: 'RULE-103', name: 'Drive Shaft Fatigue', metric: 'Vibration (mm/s)', operator: '>', limit: '0.35 mm/s', severity: 'Critical', action: 'Trigger AI RUL re-estimation & alert plant manager' }, { id: 'RULE-104', name: 'Air Pressure Drop', metric: 'Air Pressure (Bar)', operator: '<', limit: '5.2 Bar', severity: 'Warning', action: 'Signal pneumatic compressor header boost' }, { id: 'RULE-105', name: 'Low Gearbox Lubrication', metric: 'Oil Level (%)', operator: '<', limit: '70% Full', severity: 'Warning', action: 'Alert maintenance tech for oil sump top-up' }, ]); // Form State for Adding New Rule const [newRuleName, setNewRuleName] = useState(''); const [newMetric, setNewMetric] = useState('Temperature (°C)'); const [newOperator, setNewOperator] = useState('>'); const [newLimit, setNewLimit] = useState('80.0'); const [newSeverity, setNewSeverity] = useState('Critical'); const [newAction, setNewAction] = useState(''); const handleAddRule = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!newRuleName || !newAction) return; const created = { id: `RULE-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100)}`, name: newRuleName, metric: newMetric, operator: newOperator, limit: `${newLimit} ${newMetric.includes('°C') ? '°C' : newMetric.includes('Bar') ? 'Bar' : 'cN'}`, severity: newSeverity, action: newAction, }; setAlarmRules([...alarmRules, created]); setShowRuleModal(false); setNewRuleName(''); setNewAction(''); setToast(`Telemetry Rule '${created.name}' created & activated!`); setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000); }; return (
